d:
Israel faces a political deadlock after the 2026 election, with Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc winning 53 seats and Gadi Eisenkot's opposition bloc securing 48 in the 120-member Knesset. Arab-led parties won 19 seats, putting them in a decisive position as President Isaac Herzog begins consultations to determine who gets the first chance to form the next government.
